WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg
  FROM pair_averages
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.tradekind,
    p.avg_anlycount,
    p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_pair_avg AS amount_above
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_pair_avg
),
by_type AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(amount_above) AS avg_amount_above
  FROM kept_pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_amount_above,
  avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean
FROM by_type;
